github-packages-auth.description: Use the job-scoped GitHub token for exact caller-owner GitHub Packages sources in NuGet.Config.

nuget-source-config-path.description: Optional caller NuGet.Config path when it is not in the repository root.

helm-release-name.description: Helm release the AppHost deploys. Empty uses the lowercased aspire-environment, which is Aspire's default.

rollout-timeout.description: Helm duration (15m, 900s, 1h30m) for the deploy wait, the rollback wait, and the schema rollback Job.

rollback-on-failure.description: Rolls the release back to its last deployed revision when the deployment fails. The job fails either way.

exclusive.description: Stops every workload of the release before deploying, causing downtime. For releases whose schema change the previous version cannot tolerate; the deploy step then receives ARKANIS_DEPLOY_EXCLUSIVE=true.

schema-rollback-cronjob.description: Suspended CronJob in the chart, as a Helm pre-install,pre-upgrade hook or an ordinary resource, whose Job undoes the failed release's schema changes after a rollback. Skipped when absent; empty disables it.

timeout-minutes.description: Deployment job timeout. Keep it above twice rollout-timeout plus build time so a rollback is never cancelled.

upload-diagnostics.description: Uploads the deploy report artifact, including failure diagnostics, when true. The upload is best-effort and never fails the job.

source-ref.description: Optional caller checkout ref. Empty preserves the triggering commit; callers authorize selected deployment source.
